title: 1 ECS per 100 sqm FAR area for plots above 300 sqm (MPD-2047 Table 11.7, Plotted Housing c)

citations.original_text: c. 1.0 ECS for every 100 sqm FAR area, in plots exceeding 300 sqm.

notes: Read from the gazette text layer, p.222. Same rate as UBBL p.154 (viii.b); MPD-2047 measures it on FAR area, as the engine already does. Metro and MLP deductions are 'NP' (not permitted) for plotted housing. effective_from is the date of S.O. 4597(E), as for Table 7.2. Supersedes the UBBL rule for the same plots from that date.
user_caveat: MPD-2047 Table 11.7: if the permissible FAR is not achieved with this parking norm, the norm of the smaller plot category applies. Not modelled; check with the sanctioning authority.
